hypothesis: With the prior Manny body pose held fixed, changing only its root-height reference from the live first-policy reference to the contemporaneous prior reference reconstructs historical Mode B exactly.
supporting_runtime_evidence: E10 prior-body/live-ground replay matched 357 of 358 self-observation values and matched every mimic-target and terrain value; only self root-height index 0 remained different.
E11 observed the same successful static-ground branch and resolved ground Z of 210 cm at both boundaries.
E11's actual prior decomposition produced final root height 0.9379022717475891 m, float32 bits 0x3F701A5D, exactly equal to historical Mode-B self-observation index 0.
competing_explanations: Another unobserved root-frame or float-materialization boundary still distinguishes the historical snapshot.
A downstream tensor or provenance dependency changes when the prior body and prior ground reference are paired, preventing exact Mode-B actions or sections.

primary_causal_variable.name: ground_reference_epoch
primary_causal_variable.held_constant: prior Manny body source at first inference

arms.name: prior_body_live_ground
arms.role: primary causal baseline and E10 replication control

arms.name: prior_body_prior_ground
arms.override: prior body and its contemporaneous root-height reference

expected_if_hypothesis_correct: The unchanged arm is exact Mode A; the prior-body/live-ground arm reproduces E10; the coherent prior-body/prior-ground arm is exact Mode B in the raw snapshot and self-observation, mimic-target, terrain, and model-action section hashes.
falsification_observation: The E10 replication control is valid, the coherent override is confirmed consumed with valid prior body and ground evidence, but any Mode-B raw/section/action hash differs or any unrelated provenance field changes.
invalid_run_conditions: The unchanged arm is not exact Mode A.
The prior-body/live-ground arm does not reproduce the locked E10 snapshot.
The configured override is not confirmed consumed or prior evidence is incomplete.
The source tree is dirty, commits/binaries/models differ, or any locked run configuration differs.
Any raw run or evaluator artifact is malformed or missing.

metrics: exact self-observation, mimic-target, terrain, and action float32 section SHA-256
prior/live/effective body fingerprints and applied root-height reference
locked evaluator failure set and target readback ratio
active-standing snapshot, semantic trace, physics, policy, and render SHA-256

implementation_constraints: Use a default-off development-only runtime override with no production default or activation-contract change.
Do not change PoseSearch, policy timing, future poses, previous actions, physics, dispatch, thresholds, protocol, manifest, or readback requirements.
Do not add experimental values to permanent serialization or production requirements.
Retain the E10/E11 general diagnostics and distinguish experimental evidence from product success.
Run all arms on the same clean behavior commit and reused binary.
